_note: PLACEHOLDER battle tuning (docs/battle-design.md). Every number is a tunable placeholder, not approved balance. core/battle_sim.gd reads only these values and the unit battle stats in data/units/*.json; scenarios never get special-case code. Tuned against the Monte Carlo harness (scripts/battle_harness.gd).

field._note: lanes: 5 (decision 1). Bands 1-2 attacker zone, 3-4 no man's land, 5-6 defender zone. Positions run 0 (attacker edge) to 7 (defender edge); reserves wait just off the field behind the center.

terrain._note: Movement multipliers and combat effects per terrain (section 1).

weather._note: Decision 6: light effects only. Rolled from the battle seed.

combat._brace: Braced spears (brace: true, holding) cut this share of an incoming charge (approved 2026-10-01; was: cancel it entirely).
combat._pass_support: In a pass, idle melee units of the same side waiting in that lane (and the reserve, when the pass is the only open lane) add this share of their fighting men to the unit in contact.

morale._army_break: When this share of a side's starting men is dead, routed or fled, the rest of its army breaks and the battle ends.

stances._note: Battle stances (docs/war-and-realm.md §1, confirmed 2026-10-05): one per side, chosen before the battle. dealt/taken multiply the men each side kills and loses; pursuit multiplies how hard it runs down routers (a decisive win); strong_ground_taken further cuts a Defensive side's losses behind walls or on hills. AI: Aggressive when it wins at least aggressive_above of the quick simulations, Defensive below defensive_below. PLACEHOLDER numbers.

orders._note: Delays in ticks (section 3). Flank delay = field length in bands / (speed x terrain speed), then the rank reduction.

turn_face._note: Chance that a back-line unit turns to face an arriving flanker (frontal fight, no rear bonus or shock): base + morale x per_morale + general rank x per_general_rank, capped at max.

traits._note: General personality hook (section 3). No general has traits until the character system exists, except faction defaults (data/maps/<map>/factions.json battle_style).

experience._note: Decision 8. Units gain xp from kills and survival; ranks 0-9; each rank adds the bonuses below. Generals gain xp per battle and per victory.

campaign._note: PLACEHOLDER campaign side of battles (docs/battle-design.md sections 9-11, decisions 2-5, 8-11, 13).
campaign.war_rule: TEMPORARY until diplomacy: attacking a faction's army or settlement declares war on it after a confirmation; no peace yet.
campaign._captain: A dead or wounded general is replaced by a captain who fights but cannot move the army. A captain who wins an important or big battle (enemy army of at least captain_promotion_enemy_men, or any settlement battle) is promoted to general. STUB until the character and family system exists.

garrison._note: Automatic settlement garrison units per main building level, plus extra units when the settlement has walls (decision 3).

sieges._note: Section 11. A settlement with defense >= wall_threshold has walls. Wall bonus shrinks by wall_decay_per_turn per siege turn. Endurance = base + food endowment + farm level + 1 if population > population_bonus_over, capped at max_endurance (constitution: about 8).
